title: Paraguay partially refunds Ueno Bank depositors after collapse
detail: Paraguay has partially refunded Ueno Bank depositors following the bank's collapse, per France 24. Only the headline-level summary was available; refund amounts and terms are not confirmed here.

title: Authorities search Peña's official residence
detail: Authorities searched the official residence of Santiago Peña, per G1/Globo. Only the headline-level report was available; the scope of the search and items seized are not confirmed here.
